name: How often should I get my home value estimated?

mainEntity.name: How often should I get my home value estimated?

acceptedAnswer.text: The frequency of getting your home value estimated depends on your personal circumstances and market conditions. Generally, it's beneficial to get an updated estimate every few years to stay informed about your equity. However, if there are significant market shifts, major renovations to your property, or you are considering selling or refinancing, an annual or more frequent check could be beneficial, especially in dynamic markets like South Florida.
acceptedAnswer.description: Estimate your home's value every few years, or more frequently if market conditions change, you renovate, or plan to sell/refinance.
